ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(AF_ContractType__c, "VIP / Extended"), OR( ISPICKVAL(AF_ApprovalStatus__c, "Approved"), ISPICKVAL(AF_Status__c, "Reserved") ), ISBLANK(AF_ExpiryDate__c) )
